pca-zero-to-hero-from-scratch-2026: Principal Component Analysis rebuilt from scratch (power iteration + deflation, NumPy only), verified claim-by-claim on sklearn digits (1797x64) with results in results/benchmark.json, generalised to live stock-market data. Start: README.md (guide, quiz answers, verification tables), preview.html (interactive site + 8-question quiz), docs/index.html (published copy). Run: docker compose up --build; tests: docker compose run --rm test. Code: src/pca_from_scratch/pca.py (power_iteration, pca_power, pca_eigh, reconstruct), data.py (load_digits, two_pixel_view pixels 13/21, fetch_daily_returns_yahoo), evaluate.py (knn_1nn_accuracy). Experiments: run_all.py (E1-E7), make_gifs.py, make_site.py. License: MIT.
